Italy's Carabinieri returned 27 pre-Columbian artifacts to Mexico. These items, including Teotihuacan heads and fossils, were seized from illicit trade and returned via the 'My Heritage Is Not for Sale' campaign.

These artifacts were stolen in the first place, highlighting the ongoing global struggle against the illicit trade of cultural history.
